text: This staff report is about speed limit reductions on major arterial roadways, requiring City Council approval. The purpose of this report is to recommend speed limit "housekeeping" by-law amendments for Kennedy Road, between Steeles Avenue East and Danforth Road, to accurately reflect speed limit reduction recommendations previously presented to City Council and Scarborough Community Council.

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council reduce the speed limit from 60 kilometres per hour to 50 kilometres per hour on Kennedy Road between Danforth Road and Steeles Avenue East.
